title: R code integration
text:
We use the dataset from Palmer Penguins to test how to embed python code and output into html page via Quarto.
First step, we load the pengiuin data set and check what it has.

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

head(penguins)

# A tibble: 6 × 8
  species island    bill_length_mm bill_depth_mm flipper_length_mm body_mass_g
  <fct>   <fct>              <dbl>         <dbl>             <int>       <int>
1 Adelie  Torgersen           39.1          18.7               181        3750
2 Adelie  Torgersen           39.5          17.4               186        3800
3 Adelie  Torgersen           40.3          18                 195        3250
4 Adelie  Torgersen           NA            NA                  NA          NA
5 Adelie  Torgersen           36.7          19.3               193        3450
6 Adelie  Torgersen           39.3          20.6               190        3650
# ℹ 2 more variables: sex <fct>, year <int>


now let us find out the average bill length (mm) of Adelie pengiuns on Torgersen island.

pgs <- penguins |> filter(species == 'Adelie' & island == 'Torgersen') |>
    select("bill_length_mm") |>
    map_dbl(mean, na.rm = TRUE)

The average bill length of Adelie pengiuns on Torgersen is 39 mm.
